item: The host formats a project whose <TargetFrameworks> has line breaks (CacheManager.Tests)
notes: Trial 68: CacheManager.Tests writes <TargetFrameworks> over three lines with a commented-out entry, which evaluates to ';net8.0<line break>    '. The host loaded the project as 'CacheManager.Tests(net8.0<line break>    )', which matched no run's framework, so its analyzers never ran and format/check said Clean while the build reported 460 findings (fixed: the name is trimmed, and the project that then cannot load ('Required references did not load') is Not checked, exit 3; fixture tfm-with-line-break). The old engine (--engine dotnet-format) rewrites <TargetFrameworks> to the run's framework per run and formats the project, so the engines differ here. To decide: let the host do the same (set the run's framework for projects whose list has white space), or leave it Not verified. Done 2026-11-05 (owner: make the host format it too): the targets file bro injects cuts white space out of TargetFrameworks for its runs, so the host and the old engine format the project; fixture tfm-with-line-break asserts it on both engines.
